attributes.title: The Thermodynamic Wall: The Collision of AI Scaling Laws and Physical Infrastructure
attributes.author: Charlie Feng
attributes.description: A deep dive into the energy constraints facing AI scaling, exploring the collision between exponential compute demand and physical infrastructure limitations.

attributes.title: 热力学之墙：AI扩展定律与物理基础设施的碰撞
attributes.author: Charlie Feng
attributes.description: 深入剖析AI扩展面临的能源约束，探索指数级计算需求与物理基础设施限制之间的碰撞。

attributes.title: The Asymptotic Trajectory: A Comprehensive Analysis of the Path, Timing, and Impact of Artificial General Intelligence (2025–2030)
attributes.author: Charlie Feng
attributes.description: A strategic whitepaper analyzing the 'Agentic Inflection Point', the economic metamorphosis driven by autonomous agents, and the timeline to robust AGI.

attributes.title: 渐近轨迹：人工智能通用智能（AGI）路径、时机和影响的综合分析（2025-2030）
attributes.author: Charlie Feng
attributes.description: 一份战略白皮书，分析'智能体拐点'、自主智能体驱动的经济蜕变以及通往强大AGI的时间表。

attributes.title: The Evolving Landscape of Data Centers: From Terrestrial Transformations to Orbital Aspirations
attributes.author: Charlie Feng
attributes.description: The rapid evolution of AI is fundamentally reshaping the data center landscape, pushing the boundaries of existing infrastructure and sparking a wave of innovation.

attributes.title: 数据中心不断演变的格局：从地面转型到轨道愿景
attributes.author: Charlie Feng
attributes.description: 人工智能的快速发展正在从根本上重塑数据中心的格局，突破现有基础设施的界限并引发创新浪潮。

attributes.title: Making Data Centers Greener with Machine Learning
attributes.author: Charlie Feng
attributes.description: In the field of information technology, particularly in data centers, energy consumption is a pressing concern. Machine learning offers a compelling part of the solution for energy efficiency.

attributes.title: 利用机器学习打造更绿色的数据中心
attributes.author: Charlie Feng
attributes.description: 在信息技术领域，特别是在数据中心，能源消耗是一个紧迫的问题。机器学习为提高能源效率提供了一个引人注目的解决方案。
